text_block_list.text: It was one day before training.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I've made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If you truly don't understand,
let me give you a firsthand experience.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Come on, keep up!
(Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: C'mon, girls!!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, alright, let's do this just like we practiced!
My name is—huh!?

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wiser than anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A noble and wise Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then naturally?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'm the first-class star everyone looks up to~♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Which means! The name of the Umamusume
most worthy of the peak of this world is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo and Others
text_block_list.text: King Haloo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Magnificent!
Perfect! You were all simply marvelous!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
? What is it, Trainer?
You're more than welcome to applaud, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, surprised? This is my brand new call!
King's "Media Greeting"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Once I make my debut, interview requests will come pouring in! And every living room in the country will be filled with footage of me♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
So you better remember it too!
When they ask 'Who is she?',
you shout 'King!' got it?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Got it? Do you understand!?

And so, I ended up being roped into
practicing this call for quite a while—

...By the time training finally began,
both body and spirit were utterly exhausted.

Even though she's always dragging
her Trainer around like this—

Her running remains as remarkably sharp as ever.
And above all...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer!
We're going for one more set!!

Pushing oneself without compromise.
That sheer willpower is worthy of praise.

To the point where I'm genuinely looking forward to
showing the world what I can do in my debut race—

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hello. You're King Halo's
Trainer, correct?

text_block_list.name: Intellectual Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What a relief! May I ask a question?
About how you ended up teaming up with that young lady...

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eared Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no fair stealing a march on me, Trainer!
So, does she have talent inherited from her mother after all?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you came to the academy practically running away from home?!
Or is that a lie, and you were brought in as a "treasured prodigy"—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Jeez!! Hey, hold on a second~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Reporters, all of you!? WHYYY aren't you
watching the King run!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even though I personally went out of my way
to tell you what time we'd be training!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look look, I'm going to run again right now!
Don't miss the photo op, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...No, the interview is over.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Air Groove-senpai!?
What brings you here?
(...Air Groove. She serves as the Student Council Vice President, and I've heard she dived into the racing world inspired by her mother.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Both to the press and to instructing you. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, she is an inexperienced newcomer.
Not to mention, this is a crucial period right before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ambush interviews can also negatively affect her condition.
Even if unintentional, we cannot condone actions
that could potentially ruin someone's life.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am terribly sorry, but please leave.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...There was really no need to send everyone home.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: King, why did you do such a thing?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because... neither the world nor anyone else
understands me for who I truly am.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...All I ever heard around me
was my mother's name."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Mother, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you must have known.
The sheer weight of your mother's name.
...Especially in your case."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
After winning numerous G1 races, she retired to great public regret.
Today, as a top-class racing silk designer, she still holds immense influence in the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then you ought to understand full well
how the public will look upon that girl."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, plenty.
I've learned that lesson the hard way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted to take the interview now!
Because people still just treat me as 'that mother's daughter'!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume in my own right!
My debut has nothing to do with my mother's name!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then I should be recognized simply as a talented newcomer named "King Halo"!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you even consider what would happen
if you told the press that right now?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...That's... ngh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I understand your impatience.
However, do not neglect your priorities.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides... do you run
"merely to gain recognition"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Take another look, and rethink how things ought to be.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I won't back down.
Because after thinking it over again and again, that's what I chose to do."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I refuse to be boxed in as merely someone's daughter.
I am 'the first-rate Umamusume, King Halo'...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……Let me tell you once again, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You and I have a duty to show the world King Halo's talent.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says,
I have a duty to make them acknowledge me.
Both the world... and that person.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My mind was made up long ago. Before I came here,
the very person who told me I had 'no talent'...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: She's my mother.

The moment that word came up,
a dull, cold glint appeared in her eyes.

"Those eyes betrayed a depth of feud
that could not be concealed. And yet—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides... do you run
"merely to gain recognition"?

"...Just like the look in her eyes,
Air Groove's words also
weighed heavily on my mind."
